description:
Result of `skills_read`: the full text of one skill of a harness bundle. The skills are served
on demand instead of riding in the cached instruction prefix; the bundle digest
(`HarnessRef.digest`) covers these exact bytes, so a trace that pins the digest pins the skill
text the agent read.

body.description: The SKILL.md body after its frontmatter, trimmed, line endings `\n`.

description.description: The one-line description the skill index shows.

harness_digest.description: Digest of the harness bundle the skill belongs to.

title: SkillText
